source: Own measurement through `ale validate` for version 0.3 (moving tissue, tips in tissue and smoke, knocked camera head, takeovers, horizon 10 deg and fine-work 32 px/s, development material without 3D truth; generator endosim-procedure/0.4): run validate-13c4ab75 on the tree of e4ffe330, the pinned engine bfb7505 (0.1.1), the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh; solution/reference: privileged tips, scope, camera head angle of the frame and latency in place of perception and identification; rate commands through the public wire) as the oracle episode, graded in the engine's separate verifier sandbox (the renderer as its own account, the controller behind the network filter) on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/procedures.json: 12 procedures x 800 steps, rigs by tests/review/draw_rigs.py, version 0.3's salts and camera head changes by tests/review/draw_v3.py): useful_view_fraction 0.81125 (per procedure 0.8450 0.8037 0.8900 0.6913 0.7675 0.8287 0.7275 0.8512 0.8612 0.9113 0.8225 0.7350), probe pairs 203 of 554 differing (the lock's fraction is 0.1), no takeover, 45 critical actions, no lens contact, no renderer or solver restart; the canary 10 of 10 markers within 0.75 px; 125 ms a frame; verify 1481 s. Host: the author's validate host, one NVIDIA RTX 3090 on driver 535.183.01 (below Omniverse RTX's R550 floor, hence the renderer's driver check off), an Intel i9-12900K, Docker 29.10.1 in rootless mode, which cannot set a CPU quota: the engine's --cpus 8 was dropped and every process started through docker exec was pinned to 8 CPUs by affinity (OCI execCPUAffinity) instead. The same value as the native run on the same tree (e4ffe330: 0.81125; RTX 6000 Ada, driver 570.195.03, outside the engine; 0.8110417 on d31ae95b). The reference reads the simulator's state and never the picture, so the value does not depend on the renderer; over ten draws of the probes the render-free loop (tests/review/fast_eval.py's sessions) gave 0.81104 to 0.81167, with no takeover in any draw, every critical action seen usable on at least 0.727 of its steps (the rule ends a procedure under 0.25) and the lens never within 37.1 mm of the tissue (contact: 4 mm). full_at 0.98: the spread over probe draws is below 0.1 %; the margin also covers a threshold flipped by rounding on another CPU (the numerics are not pinned). Version 0.2's anchor was 0.876 (validate-7485b98b), version 0.1's 0.903. Status: tests/README.md section 7.
